citations.assessment: The matching earlier headword identifies Ben Dama as Rabbi Yishmael’s nephew and gives the snakebite locus.
The Tosefta names Eliezer ben Dama in the snakebite narrative. The checked Yerushalmi names Elazar.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

citations.reference: Torat HaAdam, The Gate of Malady, The Matter of Danger 50
citations.assessment: Ramban explicitly quotes the Yerushalmi narrative with Yehoshua. The available Yerushalmi reads Elazar, as Heilprin notes in entry 1763.

evidence.reference: Torat HaAdam, The Gate of Malady, The Matter of Danger 50

citations.assessment: The Bavli calls Ben Dama the son of Rabbi Yishmael’s sister. The father’s name and the resulting in-law relationship are the compiler’s inference from the patronym.
